name: folder-tags
description: Automatically apply tags to Obsidian notes based on their paths

scripts.format: prettier --write src test README.md package.json esbuild.config.mjs styles.css manifest.json versions.json .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test README.md package.json esbuild.config.mjs styles.css manifest.json versions.json .prettierrc.json .github/workflows/*.yml
